first_td.note: Passing is the more likely first offensive TD type (62%), but that probability is spread across multiple players. Christian McCaffrey has the highest individual first-TD probability (19.9%), mostly via rush (rush 11.3% of his 19.9%).

td_projection.label: PROJECTED OFFENSIVE TOUCHDOWNS
td_projection.basis: Mean of the per-draw sum of every simulated player's own touchdown count, over the 1500 published simulated worlds. A passing touchdown is counted once, at the receiver. Offensive touchdowns only: defensive and special-teams scores are not modelled and are not included.
td_projection.candidate_basis: Independent marginal probabilities that each player scores at least one touchdown. They are alternatives, not a predicted set of scorers, and they are not renormalised to sum to 100%.

Measured dependence on these draws: Christian McCaffrey and Mike Evans score together 0.91x as often as independence would imply (22.8% against 24.9%), which is already inside the ticket probability above. The ticket is worth 4.55% (±1.52pp), which is the probability of ALL of them scoring — far lower than any one of them alone, and not a likely outcome.

game_parlays.basis: SAFE is the official per-game ticket: it freezes at the Official Card lock and is graded. AGGRESSIVE and TD are automatic suggestions composed from propositions this game already publishes — real FanDuel rungs with their own prices and links, measured on the game's own simulated draws. They are not official tickets, are not graded and never enter the P/L.

slate.basis: A game leaves UPCOMING on its recorded status, never on the clock: a game past kickoff that is not final is LIVE and still listed. FINAL games are removed from UPCOMING and keep their results and frozen tickets. The published week advances only when every game of the week is final, so a Monday night game keeps the week open.

calibration.note: Isotonic mappings fitted out-of-sample; applied only inside the fitted support, otherwise the raw simulated probability stands. Families the server does not apply are absent, so the client cannot apply one the server refuses.

rules.published_rung_probability: canonical: measured on all 10000 simulated draws and passed through the fitted isotonic calibration. The dashboard READS it and never recomputes it.
rules.custom_threshold_probability: measured on the 1500 published draws, then calibrated with the same published mapping. Carries its Monte Carlo standard error.
rules.joint_within_a_game: one mask over shared simulated worlds — never a product of marginals
rules.probability_basis: participation-conditional: every player probability is measured on the simulated worlds in which that player plays, and a ticket's joint on the worlds in which every leg's player plays — a player who does not play is void at the book
rules.joint_across_games: product, because each game is a separate simulation with its own seed
rules.refused: a threshold at or above a series clip point, or a whole number on a continuous market

bracket.note: MOST LIKELY PLAYOFF PATH — a representative bracket built from the simulated seed probabilities and advanced with opponent-conditional win probabilities (higher seed at home, Super Bowl neutral). sb_card.note: most likely pairing from the full matchup distribution; the score is the expected margin around the measured league scoring average

season_detail.game_note: game outcomes shown are the current highest-probability result for each matchup; season record distributions come from all Monte Carlo simulations, never from counting >50% games

season_sim.game_prob_source: stored per-game Monte Carlo p_home where available (current scenario), else power-rating probit from the production game model

calibration.note: calibrated fields (p_playoffs_calibrated, p_division_calibrated) come from the walk-forward-validated Platt correction; raw simulation probabilities remain canonical and are always shown

player_season.method: actual-to-date + per-opponent-adjusted per-game gamma/Poisson x Markov games-played; leaders ranked across joint draws; QB availability discounts pass-catcher efficiency (documented)

movement.note: reasons are the changes recorded between the two runs (finals, refreshes, applied news impacts, retrains, per-team rating/QB input diffs) — movement is never given an invented cause

last_team_sim.game_prob_source: stored per-game Monte Carlo p_home where available (current scenario), else power-rating probit from the production game model

health.status_label: LIVE SEASON SIMULATION · ACTUALS THROUGH 92 FINALS

audit.attribution_source: fresh simulation n=10000 (stored production sim predates divisional tracking)

player_coverage.note: Week-0 analog backtest: 80% season-total intervals under-cover because year-to-year role/usage drift is outside the games-played + per-game-noise model — a documented limitation

confidence.definition: probability = share of simulations where the event happens; confidence = how stable that number is to Monte Carlo sampling, random seeds and rating uncertainty. A probability can be high while confidence is low, and vice versa.

tracking_only.note: game-market rows are tracked for re-evaluation only (both sides of each market are recorded, so win rate is uninformative — judge the calibrated Brier); no stake, no ROI claim

performance.scope: the frozen Official set (Library best_bets at the frozen executed price), one row per proposition, flat 1u paper stakes — the same rows as the public P/L

record.roi_denominator: wins + losses + pushes with a valid frozen price (VOID refunded, excluded)

performance.clv_coverage: 472/1132 settled frozen Officials carry a ledger CLV
performance.clv_ledger_note: ledger CLV is NOT a valid closing-line measure (KNOWN_LIMITATIONS 87); see clv_close_capture

clv_close_capture.definition: FanDuel close captured ~10 min before kickoff for the exact frozen Official proposition; no-vig CLV on the same line with both sides captured together (positive = the market moved toward the pick); one-sided markets report price CLV (includes margin); a line no longer offered is a direction only

performance.calibration_basis: the frozen pick's own probability (Official decision basis); decided WIN/LOSS rows only, pushes excluded

picks.edge_basis: raw participation-conditional model probability minus no-vig book probability

pass_rate.name: Neutral-script pass rate
pass_rate.formula: pass plays / scrimmage plays with wp in [0.20, 0.80] and > 2:00 left in the half (kneels/spikes excluded)

proe.name: Pass rate over expectation
proe.formula: mean nflverse pass_oe (pass − xpass, down/distance/score/time expectation) over scrimmage plays

sec_per_play.name: Neutral-script pace
sec_per_play.formula: drive time of possession / drive play count, drives starting in neutral script

goal_line_qb_rush_share.name: Goal-line QB rush share
goal_line_qb_rush_share.formula: designed QB rushes (rusher threw >= 20 passes that season, not a scramble) / rushes inside the 5

rb_committee_hhi.name: RB carry concentration (Herfindahl)
rb_committee_hhi.formula: sum over rushers of (carries_i / team carries)^2, QB rushes and scrambles excluded

rb1_carry_share.name: RB1 carry share
rb1_carry_share.formula: largest single-rusher carry share, QB rushes and scrambles excluded

fourth_down_go_rate.name: 4th-down aggressiveness
fourth_down_go_rate.formula: go-for-it (pass/run) / 4th & <=3 decisions with wp in [0.10, 0.90], > 2:00 left in the half, regulation

rz_pass_rate.name: Red-zone pass rate
rz_pass_rate.formula: pass plays / scrimmage plays with yardline_100 <= 20

rz_td_rate.name: Red-zone TD rate
rz_td_rate.formula: drives reaching the 20 that end in a touchdown / drives reaching the 20

top_per_game.name: Time of possession per game
top_per_game.formula: sum of drive time of possession / games

model_pick_policy.policy: highest ladder rung with model probability >= 55% (fallback: most probable rung when >= 45%); safe floor shown separately at >= 75%
model_pick_policy.evidence: store/audits/milestone_policy.json — as-of 2025 walk-forward, every probability band calibrated within ~2pp; v1 (65%) headlined the minimum rung on 64% of picks and OVER-claimed for stars (claimed .686 -> observed .641)

target_2025.note: the sim draws targets multinomially AND multiplies shares by lognormal(SHARE_NOISE_SD); the empirical excess beyond the multinomial null is the scale the lognormal should carry

week1_cohort_stability.note: error = Week-1 observed target share minus prior-season mean share, established (>=0.15 prior share, >=6 prior games) receivers, seasons 2021-2025 pooled; rookies excluded (no prior share to err against)

challenger_verdicts._tsn15: TARGET share noise 0.30->0.15, carry unchanged (matches measured empirical excess beyond multinomial sampling, 0.0-0.13 by cohort). Receiving qloss improves ~0.4% (5/6 w1-2 seasons + in-season), center MAE improves, receiving ladder mid-bins improve (+7pp -> +3pp) — but RECEPTIONS rung calibration degrades from ~±2pp to -4/-5pp over-claiming. EXPERIMENTAL — not promoted: gains small, and it trades away the best-calibrated instrument in the system.
challenger_verdicts._tsn10: As _tsn15 at 0.10 — same trade-off, receptions degradation slightly worse. EXPERIMENTAL.
challenger_verdicts._sn20: Both shares reduced to 0.20 — rushing_attempts coverage degrades (.654->.624). REJECTED.
challenger_verdicts._sn15: Both shares reduced to 0.15 — rushing_attempts F10 .138->.169 (low tail far too thin). REJECTED.
challenger_verdicts._sn10: Both shares reduced to 0.10 — worst attempts damage. REJECTED.
challenger_verdicts._csn40: CARRY share noise 0.30->0.40 (committee excess 0.37-0.49 suggested it). Attempts interval coverage improves (.698->.729) but PROPER scores worsen everywhere (attempts qloss +1%, rushing band qloss 9.06->9.52, MAE up). REJECTED — attempts under-coverage is a team-rush-volume/script question, not a share-noise one.

prop_distribution_health.final_decision: DISTRIBUTION CHALLENGER REMAINS EXPERIMENTAL — champion distribution unchanged (TARGET_SHARE_NOISE_SD=CARRY_SHARE_NOISE_SD=0.30, DISTRIBUTION_VERSION=1). The audited pathology is predominantly LOW-BIASED CENTERS (weeks 1-2 especially: F(median)=.33 in the 25-55 band), which no honest width change fixes; widths in meaningful projection bands are approximately calibrated (cov80 tie-aware .78-.84 vs nominal .80). The reduced-target-noise challenger (_tsn15) is retained as evidence but not promoted.
prop_distribution_health.explainer: F(qX) is the tie-aware share of outcomes below the predicted X% quantile — calibrated when it equals X%. cov80 is F(q90)-F(q10), nominal .80. qloss is the pinball average (proper score; lower is better). Raw inclusive coverage is inflated by the zero atom and no longer quoted.

moneyline.best_favorites_label: Highest FanDuel no-vig win probabilities this week — the most likely winners, not value bets.
moneyline.top_underdogs_label: Highest FanDuel no-vig win probabilities among underdogs — not identified value bets.

challenger.title: Moneyline challenger: does injury / QB / return / form information improve on the market?
challenger.preregistered: 2026-10-07 (Claude + ChatGPT): M0 market only; M1 + QB and availability shocks; M2 = M1 + strength/form/rest. Walk-forward train<season, test season, 2019-2025. Ridge lam=5 fixed in advance; sensitivity 1/20/100/400 reported.
challenger.benchmark: CLOSING no-vig moneyline (secondary benchmark). The point-in-time pre-lock FanDuel archive covers only 2026 W1-4, too few games for any gate; that question is answered by the prospective shadow.
challenger.verdict: FAIL at both levels. Adding these features to the closing market made forecasts worse in pooled log loss and Brier, in 6-7 of 7 seasons, at every regularization strength; picks that disagreed with the market were right less than half the time; every value-underdog and value-favourite rule lost money in every block. This shows the features did not add predictive value to the close; it does not prove how the market uses each one.

moneyline.not_a_pick: MOST LIKELY WINNER is a probability statement, not an Official pick. The game model has not beaten the closing moneyline out of sample, so no moneyline is staked, called a value bet, or counted in the P/L.
moneyline.promotion_rule: The independent game model becomes eligible for OWNER REVIEW (never automatic promotion) only after >=150 prospectively frozen games, a Brier score better than the exact pre-lock FanDuel no-vig probability, a positive logit-pool weight, and an improvement that holds in more than one separate block of weeks.

policy.primary_role: rank in the player's OWN TEAM expected opportunity, from the model's normalised expected-active usage shares: the highest projected passer, the top carry share, the top two target shares, or the team's most-targeted tight end. policy.ranked_by: model probability only — price is not a selection input
policy.not_a_recommendation: An upper-tail ticket is a low-probability proposition by construction. This is not an Official Pick, it is not in the public P/L, and no stake is suggested.

defense.basis: Recency-weighted, opponent-adjusted team defensive rates from the pipeline's own features/team_ratings, read as published levels — never reconstructed from a home-minus-away difference, which describes a matchup rather than a defence. Every def_* column in this pipeline is the mirror of the opponent's offensive production, so these are rates ALLOWED and a lower value is a better defence (sacks excepted).
defense.model_note: This context is ALREADY REFLECTED in the projection you are reading: these defensive rates feed the game model, whose margin and total set each team's expected points, which set every player's volume in the simulation. It is shown to explain a projection, never added to one.
defense.limits: Team level only. This pipeline has no cornerback assignment, no coverage or alignment data and no pressure data, so no individual receiver-versus-defender matchup is published.

2.method: Within each game: one mask over that game's 1500 published draws — the fraction of simulated worlds in which every leg from that game scores. td_slate.single_game_note: Only 1 of this week's 1 games has a priced touchdown market so far, so this IS that game's ticket — the same legs, measured the same way, not a second product. It grows into a real week ticket as the rest of the week's markets are priced.
td_slate.independence_note: Across games there is no correlation to exploit — separate simulations, separate seeds — so taking each game's best-supported scoring leg is already the highest-probability ticket at that length. The analysis that separates one ticket from another happens INSIDE a game, which is where the scoring pathways and the same-opportunity guardrail are applied.
td_slate.basis: Anytime touchdown only, from each game's own priced pool and its own simulated draws. Scoring pathways are ranks inside a player's own team on the usage shares the pipeline already publishes. First TD and 2+ TD are different markets and are never mixed in.

conventions.straight_stake: flat 1 unit risked per graded Official Pick at its frozen executed FanDuel price
conventions.parlay_stake: 1 unit total per published frozen ticket (never per leg)
conventions.parlay_payout: reported on two separate bases that are never added together: BOOK BASIS (known_*) pays a winner only from an authoritative frozen combined ticket price, and wins without one are counted as payout unavailable; LOCKED-LEG BASIS (est_*) settles the same tickets at the product of their own frozen leg prices, with push/void legs reducing at 1.0
conventions.parlay_payout_caveat: A product of leg prices is not a sportsbook parlay quote. For a same-game ticket it is an overstatement, because the legs are correlated by construction and FanDuel prices a correlated same-game parlay shorter than the independent product. Cross-game legs are independent by construction, so that product is close to a real quote but carries no hold.
conventions.missing_price: no price is ever assumed, reconstructed, or taken from closing odds
conventions.unit_display: dollars are computed client-side as units x the locally chosen unit value (default $100)
